title: All Things Are Possible
verse: Then Jesus said to him, “‘If you are able?’ All things are possible for the one who believes.
observation: We can do anything and everything God wants us to do. We have to be sure not to look at this verse in a selfish way. He is not saying all things are possible for our selfish desires. He is saying all things are possible when in pursuit of His desires.
application: Are my desires aligned with His? If so, look out!
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for having more than enough power for any obstacle we face.
